notes.title: Major Update 04.13.2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/2fad5b65985bb91afdd6d8131d29a019101fc970.png[/img]

Hello, Dungeon Warriors!

[b]Dungeon No Dungeon[/b] is still in the advanced optimization stage of the EA, and there is a certain distance from the finished version of our goal. Of course, this is not only referred to the lack of content in the current version, but also includes changes to the entire numerical system, a lot of interface rework, many UI, effect, and UE improvements, etc.

We will continue to update the above plan in the future. Although we only have four people, we will make every effort to make sure all the plans come true ASAP. Moreover, it is normal for the current version to have major changes in content, image, and design. We will do our best to protect your saves, but we also hope that you can understand that there may be changes and problems in the game in the future.

Secondly, regarding the version progress, the update of new chapters, new bosses, and new characters is currently estimated to be completed within 2 to 3 months. Thank you for your patience! In addition, while making new content, we will also continue to update some reworked content, optimized experiences, and resolved problems of the game.

New content coming soon:
[list]
[*]  Two new chapters

[*]  All-new monsters

[*]  All-new bosses

[*]  All-new battle mechanism

[*]  All-new system
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Today, we released a new dungeon currency – [b]Dungeon Gold[/b] and [b]Mysterious Magic Crystal[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/97b33155f9fa7c59072247213eefce39561c4042.png[/img]


1. Remake the economic system:
[list]
[*]  Redesigned the entire economic cycle

[*]  Redesigned all prices

[*]  Redesigned all drops

[*]  Redesigned all rewards

[*]  Unified currency – Dungeon Gold

[*]  Canceled silver and copper
[/list]
We will continue to optimize and improve and strive to make a smoother experience as soon as possible.


2. Remake the body part system:
[list]
[*]  Redesigned the body part panel

[*]  Redesigned the display of body part hit chance

[*]  Redesigned the body part hit chance

[*]  Redesigned the distribution ratio of body part values

[*]  Redesigned the character display panel in battle
[/list]
We will continue to adjust to further enhance the importance of choosing the right body part in the battle.


3. Added all-new accessories, and now the negative traits can finally be offset!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/6b78a15adb5a14f3382b995578f3c365c0d36feb.png[/img]


4. Remake the Barn:
[list]
[*]  Redesigned the interface

[*]  Redesigned the sales process

[*]  Redesigned the buttons

[*]  Added item preview interface

[*]  Added item lock function
[/list]

5. Some consumables have been enhanced, and now you can finally kick bosses without fear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/3bc91dc8d98c04d6a2cf1848ccf649477def0ee8.png[/img]


Other updates:
[olist]
[*] Redesigned battle drops

[*] Redesigned EXP and Leveling

[*] Unified all currency positions and display format

[*] Unified the size, position, and form of all close key (X)

[*] Improved the rewards of some random events

[*] Added the paid reset function of minigame – Treasure Hunt, Astral Barrier

[*] Removed minigame – Treasure Escape, Jewel Blitz

[*] Removed the opening remarks (black screen)

[*] Removed the battle preparation interface

[*] Added quality classified function to the temporary backpack

[*] Added “Unlearned” to skills that have not been obtained

[*] Added green path as a reminder for where to go next

[*] Speed up the animation of random events – the lottery machine

[*] Fixed an issue where some skill upgrades were incorrectly displayed

[*] Fixed an issue where a decimal point would appear in random events

[*] Fixed the issue that the automatic refresh of Sunset Tavern would have a negative number
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/12790571a7d8877fa0657bc2e0ba15eedfe52bdb.png[/img]

notes.title: We are so sorry! (Update Log 03.08.2021)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/25dad01b8efacbd1a6586424db3af5f5da78bb0c.png[/img]

Hey, everyone!
It's me, Dungeon No Dungeon's creator, [b]Larcen[/b]!
Today I'd like to address each one of the numerous issues that have arisen since going online.

First off, let me offer my sincerest apologies!
We're deeply sorry that so many of you, who've offered us your trust and support, have encountered a whole host of issues right after launch. We were suddenly hit by a wave of feedback concerning these problems, the vast majority of which hadn't even cropped up at all in our previous rounds of testing. As such, we've been stretched to our limits as we try and stay on top of it all. However, please rest assured that everything is being done to ensure these issues are tackled appropriately, and we're working tirelessly to improve your gaming experience.

The following measures are being taken to solve the difficulties being faced at present:
[olist]
[*]Over the next several weeks we will be sorting together and solving the problems existent today, and improving the game as fast as we can.
[*]We'll be prioritizing key issues that have the biggest impact on your overall experience.
[*]Problems with resolution and windowed mode will be dealt with as soon as possible.
[*]We'll also be coming up with improvements and conducting testing to address the feedback we've received stating that the difficulty needs to be adjusted.
[*]We will be making our [b]paid DLC Dungeon No Dungeon: Blood Knight completely free[/b], and asking Steam to [b]offer full refunds to all who have purchased it[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888989/294e609994570ea16b94b6f3e765db0713326e4d.png[/img]
        (Since Steam requires [b]at least 30 days period[/b] to change it to free,
         We will [b]temporarily remove Dungeon No Dungeon: Blood Knight DLC from the store page[/b] until it changed to free, and offering a full refund to whoever bought it when Steam allowed.) 
[*]We promise that no paid DLC will appear in the game until it leaves early access.[/olist]

Also, to express our apology: 
[olist]
[*]We'd like to present you all with a free HD wallpaper; available via the following link:
https://mega.nz/file/jggWkBiS#2RQMwf6xAsqOAnTIT2mz_Eq34TXV8DdKVzpGz5FyVKk
[*]All backers will receive a free key for the Blood Knight DLC today.[/olist]

We'll listen carefully to every suggestion you've got for us, fix every bug we can, and improve anything and everything that needs it. And that's the way it'll stay—we'll keep working to polish our game until you're all satisfied. To tell the truth, given that this is our first foray into game creation, we were at a loss as to what to do when faced with so much criticism, blame, and disapproval. It hit us like a bucket of cold water: a shock, but a welcome wake-up call to the fact that there are many areas in which we're lacking, and still need to keep working on! We'll keep on doing our best, and thank each and every one of you for your feedback. Don't lost faith in us, we'll keep forging on ahead!


Wishing you all the best,
Larcen.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
